usage.summary:
llvm-mctoll bounded Linux x86_64 profile
Use bin/llvm-mctoll -d OWNED_ELF; raised IR appears as OWNED_ELF-dis.ll.
Use paired bin/opt -passes=verify -disable-output IR and bin/clang to rebuild.
Exact mctoll ffd1e8bab0a44522b41082b473a577377dc58214 is paired with LLVM source
8dfdcc7b7bf66834a761bd8de445840ef68e4d1a (llvmorg-15.0.7). All 21 mctoll C++
translation units were compiled from the unmodified pinned source. Missing
private X86 interfaces in the distribution SDK are supplied by generated tables
and matching original LLVM function implementations in a documented build profile.
LLVM itself was not rebuilt in full: the libraries/toolchain are fixed official
Ubuntu LLVM15.0.7-14build3 packages. Exact source, input debs, logs and offline
build entry are supplied at workers/075-mctoll-support in the accompanying inputs.
Target Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and dependency notices are preserved. The exact target source is also
included in this prefix. Private runtime libraries are resolved from lib/.
Host Linux x86_64 glibc, libstdc++, GCC/binutils and standard LLVM runtime libraries
are prerequisites. Acceptance uses owned non-PIE scalar integer C with argc input,
loops, conditional branches, LLVM verification and 11 independent execution cases.
No general C++, vector, Windows, ARM/RISC-V or arbitrary binary lifting claim.
